art_of_desire_body.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
每当此牌放逐一张红色牌时，抽一张牌并获得1点生命。
art_of_desire_body.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.
Whenever this banishes a red card, draw a card and gain 1{h}.

art_of_desire_mind.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
每当此牌放逐一张蓝色牌时，抽一张牌并获得1点生命。
art_of_desire_mind.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.
Whenever this banishes a blue card, draw a card and gain 1{h}.

art_of_desire_soul.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
每当此牌放逐一张黄色牌时，抽一张牌并获得1点生命。
art_of_desire_soul.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.
Whenever this banishes a yellow card, draw a card and gain 1{h}.

art_of_the_dragon_blood.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，若其为龙裔，它获得再动，且本回合你使用的接下来3张龙裔牌使用费用减少1点资源。
art_of_the_dragon_blood.text_en: When this attacks, if it is Draconic, it gets go again and the next 3 Draconic cards you play this turn cost {r} less to play.

art_of_the_dragon_claw.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，若其为龙裔，它获得“当此牌命中英雄时，摧毁其军械库中的所有牌。”
art_of_the_dragon_claw.text_en: When this attacks, if it is Draconic, it gets "When this hits a hero, destroy all cards in their arsenal."

art_of_the_dragon_fire.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，若其为龙裔，对任意目标造成2点伤害。
art_of_the_dragon_fire.text_en: When this attacks, if it is Draconic, deal 2 damage to any target.

art_of_the_dragon_scale.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，若其为龙裔，它获得“当此牌命中英雄时，在其控制的一件装备上放置一个-1防御指示物。然后若其防御为0，摧毁它。”
art_of_the_dragon_scale.text_en: When this attacks, if it is Draconic, it gets "When this hits a hero, put a -1{d} counter on an equipment they control. Then if it has 0{d}, destroy it."

art_of_the_phoenix_war.text_zh:
作为使用此牌的额外费用，弃一张凤凰烈焰。
本回合你控制的龙裔攻击行动牌获得+1力量。
抽2张牌。
art_of_the_phoenix_war.text_en:
As an additional cost to play this, discard a Phoenix Flame.
Draconic attack action cards you control get +1{p} this turn.
Draw 2 card.

art_of_war.text_zh:
选择2个；
本回合你控制的攻击行动牌获得+1力量和+1防御。
本回合你使用的下一张攻击行动牌获得再动。
直到回合结束，你可以用军械库中的攻击行动牌防御。
你可以放逐你手牌中的一张攻击行动牌。若如此做，抽2张牌。
art_of_war.text_en:
Choose 2;

Attack action cards you control gain +1{p} and +1{d} this turn.
The next attack action card you play this turn gains go again.
Until end of turn, you may defend with attack action cards from arsenal.
You may banish an attack action card from your hand. If you do, draw 2 cards.

ash.type_zh: 龙裔 幻术师 衍生物·Ash
ash.text_zh: 材料——当灰烬位于某个物体之下时，该物体具有虚击。
ash.text_en: Material - While Ash is under an object, that object has phantasm.

asking_for_trouble.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，在攻击英雄的控制下创造一个活力衍生物。
asking_for_trouble.text_en: When this defends, create a Vigor token under the attacking hero's control.

aspect_of_tiger_body.text_zh: 连击——当此牌攻击时，若一张红色攻击行动牌是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得再动，并在你的放逐区中创造一张卧虎。本回合你可以使用它。
aspect_of_tiger_body.text_en: Combo - When this attacks, if a red attack action card was the last attack this combat chain, this gets go again and create a Crouching Tiger in your banished zone. You may play it this turn.

aspect_of_tiger_mind.text_zh: 连击——当此牌攻击时，若一张蓝色攻击行动牌是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得再动，并在你的放逐区中创造一张卧虎。本回合你可以使用它。
aspect_of_tiger_mind.text_en: Combo - When this attacks, if a blue attack action card was the last attack this combat chain, this gets go again and create a Crouching Tiger in your banished zone. You may play it this turn.

aspect_of_tiger_soul.text_zh: 连击——当此牌攻击时，若一张黄色攻击行动牌是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得再动，并在你的放逐区中创造一张卧虎。本回合你可以使用它。
aspect_of_tiger_soul.text_en: Combo - When this attacks, if a yellow attack action card was the last attack this combat chain, this gets go again and create a Crouching Tiger in your banished zone. You may play it this turn.

assault_and_battery.text_zh:
捶胸
当此牌攻击时，若本回合你捶胸过，创造一个敏捷衍生物。
assault_and_battery.text_en:
Beat Chest
When this attacks, if you've beaten chest this turn, create an Agility token.

assembly_module.text_zh:
上弦
此牌进入竞技场时带有一个蒸汽指示物。在你的回合开始时，除非你从此牌上移除一个蒸汽指示物，否则摧毁它。
行动——横置此牌：从你的牌库中搜寻一张超频驱动器，将其放入竞技场，然后洗牌。
assembly_module.text_en:
Crank
This enters the arena with a stream counter. At the start of your turn, destroy this unless you remove a steam counter from it.
Action - {t}: Search your deck for a Hyper Driver, put it into the arena, then shuffle.

astral_assault.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，你可以摧毁你控制的一个闪电流转。若如此做，此牌获得+2力量。
astral_assault.text_en: When this attacks, you may destroy a Lightning Flow you control. If you do, this gets +2{p}.

astral_bridge.type_zh: 闪电 法师 瞬间
astral_bridge.text_zh:
将你牌库顶的一张牌置入你的坟场。若其为瞬间，本回合你可以使用它。
星落——若本回合有一张瞬间牌被置入你的坟场，对目标英雄造成1点秘法伤害。
astral_bridge.text_en:
Put the top card of your deck into your graveyard. If it's an instant, you may play it this turn.
Starfall - If an instant has been put into your graveyard this turn, deal 1 arcane damage to target hero.

astral_etchings.text_zh:
在你控制的具有结界的目标光环上放置三个+1力量指示物。
若你控制一个幻质护盾，你可以将此牌当作瞬间使用。
astral_etchings.text_en:
Put three +1{p} counters on target aura with ward you control.
If you control a Spectral Shield, you may play this as though it were an instant.

astral_strike.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，若本回合你摧毁过一个闪电流转，选择其一；
- 抽一张牌。
- 此牌获得+2力量。
- 此牌获得再动。
astral_strike.text_en:
When this attacks, if you've destroyed a Lightning Flow this turn, choose 1;
- Draw a card.
- This gets +2{p}.
- This gets go again.

astravolt_elemental.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，你可以弃一张瞬间牌。若如此做，抽一张牌并创造一个闪电化身衍生物。
astravolt_elemental.text_en: When this attacks, you may discard an instant card. If you do, draw a card and create an Embodiment of Lightning token.

attention_grabbers.text_zh:
当此牌防御时，你可以从你控制的一个光环上移除一个悬念指示物。若如此做，此链环中此牌获得+2防御。
刃碎
attention_grabbers.text_en:
When this defends, you may remove a suspense counter from an aura you control. If you do, this gets +2{d} this chain link.
Blade Break

attune_with_cosmic_vibrations.text_zh: 当此牌攻击英雄或防御英雄的攻击时，展示该英雄牌库顶的一张牌。若被展示的牌为蓝色，此牌获得+3力量和+3防御。
attune_with_cosmic_vibrations.text_en: When this attacks a hero or defends a hero's attack, reveal the top card of their deck. If the revealed card is blue, this gets +3{p} and +3{d}.

auric_shards.type_zh: 闪电 幻术师 瞬间·光环
auric_shards.text_zh:
当此牌进入竞技场时，至多1个目标具有碎片的攻击获得+1力量。若此牌带有一个全息指示物，改为该攻击获得+4力量。
结界1
auric_shards.text_en:
When this enters the arena, up to 1 target attack with fragment gets +1{p}. If this has a holo counter, instead the attack gets +4{p}.
Ward 1

aurora.text_zh:
每回合一次瞬间——支付2点资源：创造一个闪电化身衍生物。仅当本回合你使用过一张闪电牌时才能启动此异能。
闪电精华
aurora.text_en:
Once per Turn Instant - {r}{r}: Create an Embodiment of Lightning token. Activate this only if you've played a Lightning card this turn.
Essence of Lightning

aurora_emissary_of_lightning.text_zh: 瞬间——支付2点资源，横置此牌，摧毁你控制的一个闪电流转：创造一个闪电化身衍生物。
aurora_emissary_of_lightning.text_en: Instant - {r}{r}, {t}, destroy a Lightning Flow you control: Create an Embodiment of Lightning token.

aurora_legacy_of_tempest.type_zh: 闪电 符文剑士 英雄
aurora_legacy_of_tempest.text_zh: 瞬间——支付2点资源，横置此牌，摧毁你控制的一个闪电流转：创造一个闪电化身衍生物。
aurora_legacy_of_tempest.text_en: Instant - {r}{r}, {t}, destroy a Lightning Flow you control: Create an Embodiment of Lightning token.

aurora_shooting_star.type_zh: 元素 符文剑士 英雄
aurora_shooting_star.text_zh:
每回合一次瞬间——支付2点资源：创造一个闪电化身衍生物。仅当本回合你使用过一张闪电牌时才能启动此异能。
闪电精华
aurora_shooting_star.text_en:
Once per Turn Instant - {r}{r}: Create an Embodiment of Lightning token. Activate this only if you've played a Lightning card this turn.
Essence of Lightning

aurum_aegis.text_zh:
维克托专精
此牌计为一个金币。
淬炼
aurum_aegis.text_en:
Victor Specialization
This counts as a Gold.
Temper

authority_of_ataya.text_zh:
传奇
当此牌被资源时，本回合对手使用防御反应牌需额外支付1点资源。
authority_of_ataya.text_en:
Legendary
When this is pitched, defense reaction cards cost opponents an additional {r} to play this turn.

autosave_script.text_zh:
上弦
此牌进入竞技场时带有一个蒸汽指示物。在你的回合开始时，除非你从此牌上移除一个蒸汽指示物，否则摧毁它。
你的机械师攻击行动牌获得“当此牌命中时，将其置于其拥有者的牌库底。”
autosave_script.text_en:
Crank
This enters the arena with a steam counter. At the start of your turn, destroy this unless you remove a steam counter from it.
Your Mechanologist attack action cards get "When this hits, put it on the bottom of its owner's deck."

avalon_archangel_of_rebirth.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击
当阿瓦隆攻击时，你可以放逐你的英雄的灵魂中的一张牌。若如此做，将你坟场中的一张黄色牌置于你的牌库顶。
结界4
avalon_archangel_of_rebirth.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack
When Avalon attacks, you may banish a card from your hero's soul. If you do, put a yellow card from your graveyard on top of your deck.
Ward 4

avast_ye.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次海盗盟友攻击获得再动，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，创造一个金币衍生物。”
再动
avast_ye.text_en:
Your next Pirate ally attack this turn gets go again and "When this hits a hero, create a Gold token."
Go again

awakening.text_zh:
大地融合
若你的生命低于一位对手英雄，创造与你与对手生命差等量的地震涌动衍生物。若觉醒已融合，改为创造两倍数量的地震涌动衍生物。
从你的牌库中搜寻一张费用小于或等于你控制的地震涌动衍生物数量的守护者攻击行动牌，展示它，将其置入你的手牌，然后洗牌。
awakening.text_en:
Earth Fusion
If you have less {h} than an opposing hero, create Seismic Surge tokens equal to the difference. If Awakening was fused, instead create twice that many Seismic Surge tokens.
Search your deck for a Guardian attack action card with cost less than or equal to the number of Seismic Surge tokens you control, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle your deck.

awakening_bellow.text_zh:
本回合你使用的下一张蛮将攻击行动牌获得+3力量。
威吓
再动
awakening_bellow.text_en:
The next Brute attack action card you play this turn gains +3{p}.
Intimidate
Go again

azalea.text_zh: 每回合一次行动——费用0：将你军械库中的一张牌置于你的牌库底。若如此做，将你牌库顶的一张牌正面朝上放入你的军械库。若其为箭矢牌，它直到回合结束获得支配。再动
azalea.text_en: Once per Turn Action - 0: Put a card from your arsenal on the bottom of your deck. If you do, put the top card of your deck face up into your arsenal. If it's an arrow card, it gains dominate until end of turn. Go again

azalea_ace_in_the_hole.text_zh: 每回合一次行动——费用0：将你军械库中的一张牌置于你的牌库底。若如此做，将你牌库顶的一张牌正面朝上放入你的军械库。若其为箭矢牌，它直到回合结束获得支配。再动
azalea_ace_in_the_hole.text_en: Once per Turn Action - 0: Put a card from your arsenal on the bottom of your deck. If you do, put the top card of your deck face up into your arsenal. If it's an arrow card, it gains dominate until end of turn. Go again

azvolai.text_zh: 每当阿兹沃莱攻击时，你可以让他对至多任意2个目标各造成1点秘法伤害。
azvolai.text_en: Whenever Azvolai attacks, you may have him deal 1 arcane damage to up to any 2 targets.
